compiled_state.title: [ci-review-corpus-delta]: relative _REPO_ROOT derivation -> test_repo_root_no_relative_derivation fails
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

ci-review-corpus-delta.sh must not use relative path traversal (cd ../.. from _PLUGIN_ROOT) to derive _REPO_ROOT. Plugin scripts must use git rev-parse --show-toplevel or an equivalent portable pattern.

#### Actual Behavior

Line 34: _REPO_ROOT="\$(cd "\$_PLUGIN_ROOT/../.." && pwd)" — uses relative path derivation blocked by test_repo_root_no_relative_derivation and test_no_relative_paths_in_plugin_scripts in CI.

Script Tests FAILED: PASSED: 5374  FAILED: 2

comments.body: Classification: mechanical — relative path derivation in plugin script blocked by portability test. Fix: replace line 34 cd traversal with git rev-parse --show-toplevel
comments.author: Test
